html:
Operated by Vietlook Travel, the Cham Island Full Day Tour is an ideal getaway for travelers who love nature, the sea, and outdoor activities. Located just off the coast of Hoi An, Cham Island is a UNESCO-recognized Biosphere Reserve, famous for its crystal-clear water, coral reefs, and peaceful island life.

This tour offers a perfect combination of sightseeing, swimming, snorkeling, and relaxation, with convenient transportation, professional service, and a delicious seafood lunch on the island.

ITINERARY

07:30 – 08:30
Driver and English-speaking tour guide from Vietlook Travel pick you up at your hotel in Da Nang. Depart for Cua Dai Beach via the “five-star street” connecting Da Nang and Hoi An, passing many luxury resorts. Distance is approximately 30 km from Da Nang city center.

09:15
Board a speed motorboat and begin an exciting journey to Cham Island. The island is located about 8 nautical miles east of Cua Dai Beach. Enjoy the thrilling experience as the boat rides across the waves.

09:40
Arrive at Bai Lang Pier on Cham Island. Start exploring the island with visits to:

  • Sa Huynh Museum

  • Cham Island Marine Protected Area

  • Hai Tang Pagoda

  • Tan Hiep Seafood Market (shopping time)

10:30
Free time for relaxing, swimming, and taking photos.

12:00
Enjoy lunch at Bai Ong Beach.

14:00
Return to the boat, depart from Bai Lang to Hon Dai, then head back to Hoi An pier (Hoai River).

15:00 – 15:30
Drop-off at your hotel.
End of tour services. Thank you for traveling with Vietlook Travel!

TOUR PRICE: USD 20 / person

INCLUSIONS

  • Air-conditioned coach for hotel transfers

  • Professional English-speaking tour guide

  • Round-trip motorboat: Hoi An Pier – Cham Island

  • Lunch on Cham Island

  • Mineral water

  • Snorkeling service on Cham Island

  • All entrance fees as per itinerary

IMPORTANT NOTES

  • Please provide personal information: Full name, year of birth, gender, nationality, and contact details.

  • Children policy:

    • Under 1 year old: Free of charge

    • 1–4 years old: 50% of adult price (half portion lunch)

    • 5–9 years old: 80% of adult price (half portion lunch)

    • Above 9 years old: Full adult price
